summary.en: A benchmark examines how DIA search and quantitative-analysis choices interact, emphasizing accuracy and false-discovery control alongside identification depth.
summary.zh: DIA 搜索与定量分析的组合评测，把倍数变化准确性和假发现率控制与鉴定深度放在同一评价框架中。

en: Reliable quantitative proteomics depends on the entire analysis pipeline, not just a search engine. Today's selection examines the interaction between identification and downstream statistical tools.

The review also covered metabolomics, spectral searching, ion mobility and spatial metabolomics. Some recent candidates could not be included because original records or complete author information remained unverified; coverage is not exhaustive.
zh: 可靠的定量蛋白组分析取决于整条处理流程，而不只是搜索引擎。今天的研究聚焦鉴定工具与下游统计方法之间的配合。
本轮同时关注代谢组、谱库检索、离子淌度及空间代谢组。部分近期候选的原始记录或完整作者信息尚未核实，未纳入本篇；覆盖并非穷尽。

papers.title: Comparison Study of Data Processing Workflows for Label-Free DIA Quantitative Proteomics

read_scope.en: Publisher abstract and indexed metadata; full text not read and results not reproduced.
read_scope.zh: 出版商摘要及索引元数据阅读；未读全文，未复现。

commentary.zh: 研究将 DIA-NN、DIA-Umpire、diaTracer 和 MSFragger-DIA 四种搜索流程与 directLFQ、AlphaPeptStats、Triqler 及简单 t 检验四种定量分析工具组合，在两个加标基准数据集上同时评价鉴定数、差异检测灵敏度、倍数变化准确性与定量假发现率控制。其价值在于把检索与下游统计作为联动流程评测，而非仅按鉴定数量选工具；摘要未披露具体优胜组合或效应量，不能据此给出软件排名，且两个加标数据集对真实异质样本的外推仍需全文核查。
commentary.en: The study combines four DIA search workflows (DIA-NN, DIA-Umpire, diaTracer and MSFragger-DIA) with four quantitative-analysis tools (directLFQ, AlphaPeptStats, Triqler and a simple t test), evaluating identification counts, differential-detection sensitivity, fold-change accuracy and quantitative false-discovery-rate control on two spike-in benchmarks. Its practical value is to assess search and downstream statistics as a coupled pipeline rather than select tools by identification count alone; the abstract does not disclose winning combinations or effect sizes, and generalization from two spike-in datasets to heterogeneous real samples requires full-text assessment.
